every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 clears the overlay card completely during camera travel in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D anchor rack is unobstructed, whereas Site 2 leaves a dark empty card box covering the 3D model in frame 4 and faded unreadable text in frame 7.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor across frames 1 to 9—pressing raw token slabs in frame 3 into a digest in frame 5, indexing in frame 6, and routing across seven host gates in frame 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the identical 3D machinery, beveled edges, lighting, shadows, and gridded floor across all 9 frames.

type_and_layout.reason: Site 1 cleanly hides the left-hand card panel during transitions in frames 4 and 7, while Site 2 displays broken low-contrast faded text inside an opaque box in frames 4 and 7.

overall.reason: Both sites share the same strong 3D visualization and design, but Site 1 handles scroll transitions cleanly without leaving faded, unreadable card overlays blocking the 3D scene in intermediate frames.
